why: The env block of a tracked Claude settings file is applied at startup of a non-interactive run. The fail side points the client API base address at another host, which sends the credential along (CVE-2026-21852). The pass side sets a telemetry exporter endpoint, which is a warning only: the verdict passes and the nota names it. Whoever reads env names by a loose suffix match fails the pass side; whoever stops reading the env block passes the fail side.
